long_description: Document Systems composes deterministic proposal Expressions, enforces caller-reviewed semantic invariants, validates supplied lineage, and compiles portable content-addressed release packets. Four bounded profiles cover normative, operational, research, and human-agent documents. Every result remains proposal-scoped and not persisted by the service; validation never claims source truth, authority, behavioral success, acceptance, operative status, repository head, or complete lineage.
capabilities: Validate structure, semantic invariants, evidence boundaries, and supplied lineage
Compile and verify portable release packets
Render traceable human-review, human-action, and machine views
starter_prompts: Model this policy requirement as a proposal-scoped normative Expression.
Audit this Expression's integrity, readiness, lineage, and evidence boundaries.
Render a traceable human-action view from this operational Expression.
release_notes: Document Systems 0.3.0 adds caller-reviewed semantic assertions, mandatory typed allocation and evaluation fields, a one-call release-packet compiler, portable packet verification, and fail-closed semantic release gates. The public MCP remains stateless, read-only, and unauthenticated.
